## Description {#details}

<p>Defines the object file and target independent interfaces used by the assembler backend to write native file format object files.</p>


<p>The object writer contains a few callbacks used by the assembler to allow the object writer to modify the assembler data structures at appropriate points. Once assembly is complete, the object writer is given the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcassembler">MCAssembler</a> instance, which contains all the symbol and section data which should be emitted as part of <a href="#ab1d5b19bf0e12d0f42b937d7e534b797">writeObject()</a>.</p>
